gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase 3 Randomized Double-blind, Controlled Study of ICT-107 With Maintenance Temozolomide (TMZ) in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Following Resection and Concomitant TMZ Chemoradiotherapy

candidate_evidence.quote: Autologous dendritic cells pulsed with peptides associated with tumor antigens
Arm 1 will receive ICT-107 in combination with the standard of care, temozolomide (TMZ).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Following Resection and Concomitant TMZ Chemoradiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: ICT-107 consists of dendritic cells, prepared from autologous mononuclear cells that are pulsed with six synthetic peptides that were derived from tumor associated antigens (TAA) present on glioblastoma tumor cells.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous dendritic-cell vaccine pulsed with six tumour-associated antigen peptides (cancer vaccine / cell therapy)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Reinfusion with the pulsed dendritic cells should stimulate cytotoxic T cells to specifically target glioblastoma tumour cells.

role_evidence.quote: Arm 1 will receive ICT-107 in combination with the standard of care, temozolomide (TMZ).
Arm 2 will receive TMZ with a blinded control.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care
placebo control consisting of autologous monocyte-enriched PBMC (cell product, not a drug)

source_quote.quote: All subjects must have glioblastoma tissue that has tumor assessment for MGMT methylation status prior to randomization (for stratification).
Subjects with glioblastoma mutated IDH by Immunohistochemistry (IHC)

coder_notes: Only investigational agent is ICT-107, an autologous dendritic-cell peptide vaccine -> excluded_intervention_type; temozolomide is standard backbone in both arms. cns5_terminology: record uses 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' (historical) but excludes IDH-mutant glioblastoma by IHC, treated as an IDH-wildtype requirement -> cns5 per the both-criteria rule; adjudicator may prefer historical since the record does not literally require IDH-wildtype and itself refers to 'glioblastoma mutated IDH'. IDH row is the IDH-mutant exclusion (IDH-wildtype used to define GBM). MGMT also analysed in secondary OS subgroup outcomes. HLA-A2 positivity required (germline, not recorded). Filgrastim allowed for neutropenia prevention (not a protocol intervention, not listed). Start date likely pre-2020 but S2 is [CODE].
